correctness.rationale: For a finite labelled W and Gödel implication, every strictly increasing endpoint-fixing homeomorphism h commutes with min, max and a->b (since it preserves the <= predicate and 1). It commutes with all finite modal infima/suprema by monotonicity. Structural induction yields e_{hR,he}(w,phi)=h(e_{R,e}(w,phi)) for all formulas in the language without pinned intermediate truth constants. Its inverse bijects valuations, so frame validity is invariant. Classify N=m^2 labelled entries by whether each is endpoint 0/1 or in one of k positive ordered interior equality blocks; piecewise-linear h maps interior levels to i/(k+1), defining a unique canonical representative per orbit. Choose s interior entries, assign 2 endpoints to others, and ordered-partition the s entries: T_N=sum_s binom(N,s)2^(N-s) sum_k k! S(s,k). Independently recomputed T1=3,T2=11,T3=51,T4=299,T9=28349043 with a distinct ordered-block recurrence; the universal proof is algebraic, not inferred from finite enumeration. T counts regrading orbits and only upper-bounds distinct modal logics.
